# Tequilas Tacos & Bar - Charlotte

> Tequilas Tacos & Bar - Charlotte is a Mexican restaurant in Charlotte, NC serving tacos, tequila, margaritas, molcajetes, and Louisiana-style Mexican seafood.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://tequilastacosbar.com/): Restaurant overview, signatures, gallery preview, reviews, hours, and contact details.
- [Food menu](https://tequilastacosbar.com/menu/): Full kitchen and cantina food menu with tacos, fajitas, burritos, enchiladas, lunch, kids, sides, and desserts.
- [Seafood menu](https://tequilastacosbar.com/seafood/): Seafood-focused menu with mariscos, camarones, aguachiles, ceviches, mojarras, molcajetes, and caldos.
- [Drinks menu](https://tequilastacosbar.com/drinks/): Margaritas, frozen specials, tequila flights, beers, micheladas, cocktails, wines, sangria, and aguas.
- [Gallery](https://tequilastacosbar.com/gallery/): Food, drink, interior, and restaurant photography.
- [Events](https://tequilastacosbar.com/events/): Restaurant events and calendar links.
- [Become a VIP](https://tequilastacosbar.com/vip/): VIP club signup for rewards and offers.
- [Careers](https://tequilastacosbar.com/careers/): Hiring and job interest page.

## Ordering And Contact

- [Order online](https://tequilastacosbar.com/comingsoon): Online ordering destination.
- [Google Maps directions](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Google&query_place_id=ChIJpTAzUaceVIgRkeVtc24T1k4): Directions to 8650 University City Blvd, Charlotte, NC 28213.
